question.text: In the complex <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo>[</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>]</mo></math> . If coordination number is X and oxidation number of Th is Y. The sum of X + Y is?

solution.text:
K4ThC2O42H2O
4+Y+2-2+0=0
Y=+2 (oxidation number)
Coordination number (X)=2×2+2=6
X+Y=6+2=8
